name: tldr-window
description: A side pane that keeps a TL;DR of what this Claude window is working on, refreshed after each turn from the cached transcript

engine.title: Summary engine
engine.description: fork: ask the session's own model over its cached transcript (full context, cache-read tokens). haiku: send a condensed digest of recent messages to Haiku (cheaper per call on big sessions, less context).

refresh.title: When to refresh
refresh.description: every-turn: after each turn Claude finishes. manual: only when you run /tldr or press Refresh.

retitle_session.title: Retitle the session
retitle_session.description: Use the TL;DR title as the session title on your next prompt, so the window and /resume list name what it is doing. This replaces a name you gave with /rename.
